summary: Waldencast plc filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing its filing of a Form 15 with the SEC to terminate registration of its Class A Ordinary Shares and redeemable warrants under Section 12(g) and suspend Section 15(d) reporting obligations, the US equivalent of a voluntary delisting and deregistration. Periodic and current reports are suspended immediately; termination becomes effective 90 days after filing. Shares and warrants now quote on OTC Pink Limited under MLKMF and MLKWF, each warrant exercisable at $11.50. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch timing, withdrawal risk, and thin OTC liquidity.
